Corporate Makeup Signature Look Training

A 1-day corporate makeup program: a polished, professional signature look for work, events, and camera, with skincare prep, day-to-night transitions, and career tips.

All Levels · Corporate · 1 day · PHP 7,500

Send an inquiry

Who this course is for

Working professionals who want a consistent, camera-ready presence, plus artists adding corporate and executive clients to their roster.

PHP 7,500

per student · all materials included

Ask about this course

Tuition covers all training materials, your certificate, portfolio images, and OJT opportunities. Intake dates open as seats fill; ask for the next available dates.

What you will cover

  1. 01

    Corporate Makeup and Skincare Prep

    Styles suited to corporate environments and the skincare prep that builds a flawless base.

  2. 02

    Your Signature Look

    A polished, natural everyday look that emphasizes your features while staying professional.

  3. 03

    Event and Camera Makeup

    Enhancing features for photography and video, with long-lasting event makeup.

  4. 04

    Day to Night Transition

    Turn a daytime look into evening elegance with depth and drama.

  5. 05

    Application Techniques and Hygiene

    Foundation, contour, highlight, and corporate-appropriate eyes, plus professional hygiene standards and etiquette.

  6. 06

    Business and Marketing Tips

    Building a corporate makeup career, marketing yourself, and managing client consultations.

What you will receive

  • All training materials provided
  • Certificate of completion
  • Portfolio images of your work
  • OJT at film, TV, stage, and theatre performances
  • 10% discount on succeeding courses
  • Makeup Academy Manila welcome gift

How training works

Guided hands-on sessions with one-on-one feedback throughout the day, closing with a recap of key learnings and certificate distribution.
